purpose: test metric viability of three-RGB-only anchor alignment against sensor depth, before designing any reliability score
hypothesis: fixed train-anchor OLS inverse-depth alignment beats a per-view anchor-median constant-depth control on independently measured GT in all three selected views
non_claims: not comparable to historical LLFF 504x378 GS runs

forbidden_predictor_inputs: previous diagnostic errors and oracle outputs

camera_adapter.resize: cv2.INTER_AREA exactly 1/6, no crop, no undistortion, no EXIF transpose
camera_adapter.parameter_order: fx fy cx cy k1 k2 p1 p2 k3 k4 sx1 sy1
camera_adapter.camera_API: pycolmap 4.2.1 in dedicated CPU environment, not legacy gsplat parser
camera_adapter.scale_intrinsics: fx fy cx cy divided by 6; distortion unchanged
camera_adapter.pose: normalize original rounded quaternion then Hamilton wxyz world-to-camera; never optimize poses or intrinsics
camera_adapter.scene_units: original meters; no scene normalization, GT fit or ICP
camera_adapter.Z: axial camera Z; do not normalize the lifted (u,v,1) ray

anchors.status: proposed future CPU implementation; not run
anchors.pairs: all three unordered pairs, lexicographic names
anchors.matching: BF L2, KNN k=2 in both directions; strict distance ratio<0.8 in both directions and reciprocal best match; no learned matcher, RANSAC pose estimation or guided retry
anchors.tracks: union accepted pair edges; reject entire component with multiple features from same image; keep tracks with 2 or 3 distinct selected images
anchors.triangulation: float64 homogeneous DLT SVD from measured keypoints and known poses after full-model ray lifting; no refinement
anchors.coordinates_exported: actual SIFT measurement indices, never fitted reprojections
anchors.collision: per-image floor(measurement+0.5) pixel: keep smallest positive Z; ties stable track signature
anchors.on_insufficient_support: blocked_anchor_support; retain artifacts, stop without changing images, filters or features

model.name: Depth Anything V2 Small relative inverse depth
model.output_upsampling: upstream bilinear align_corners=True; do not replace with a new decoder

alignment.fit: per-image unweighted float64 OLS on raw prediction bilinearly sampled at measured training anchor coordinates
alignment.after_invalid_alignment: failed_alignment; no sign flip, robust fitting, oracle fit, clipping fallback or GT-based anchor rejection

controls.constant: per-image q_const=median(1/Z_anchor), Z_const=1/q_const; same anchors and fixed evaluation domain
controls.spatial_gradient_rank: lower score first; sqrt(central_dx(q_pred)^2+central_dy(q_pred)^2)/median(1/Z_anchor), central work-grid step1; invalid score +infinity; no GT or feature confidence; if any central-difference contributor is invalid, score +infinity; score-unavailable is distinct from prediction-invalid
controls.gradient_interpolation: evaluate centered differences at work pixels then bilinearly sample scores at native GT centers

random_ranks.algorithm: NumPy PCG64 permutation of per-image GT-valid fixed-domain native pixels in row-major order; evaluator-only; report every seed and mean range

controls.oracle_rank: ascending capped per-pixel error, evaluator-only, never exported to predictor
controls.tie_break: native row-major index ascending; invalid gradient scores rank last
controls.interpretation: gradient, random and oracle are descriptive controls; no new reliability-score success gate

evaluation.run_after: all three predictions/anchors/constants and predictor access manifests hash-sealed; no per-view GT feedback before predictions finish
evaluation.depth_read: native little-endian float32; finite positive GT only; no filling, resizing or GT interpolation
evaluation.fixed_domain: native pixels whose mapped work centers satisfy 2<=x<=W_work-3 and 2<=y<=H_work-3; domain independent of prediction validity
evaluation.mapping: bilinear sample aligned inverse-Z q at mapped center, invert only after sampling; all four contributors finite and positive, otherwise invalid
evaluation.invalid_prediction: nonfinite or q<=1e-6 or any invalid bilinear contributor; primary error penalty1, never dropped
evaluation.primary_aggregation: compute each image mean then equally average all three images; never pool pixels across images
secondary: uncapped AbsRel on valid predictions alongside invalid rate and denominator
mean absolute inverse-Z error normalized by train median inverse-Z on valid predictions; invalid rate separate
per-image 12x9 block counts and means, zero-support blocks unknown
per-coverage capped error, invalid count, retained GT count for every gradient/random/oracle ranking
raw anchor GT residual at native floor(native_corner_coordinate) only if that exact native pixel has valid GT; no nearest-valid search; minimum30 per view for an interpreted anchor-reference summary
evaluation.unknowns: GT unavailable stays unknown; spatially excluded counts and predictor-invalid counts reported separately
evaluation.inference_unit: one development scene; three correlated images; no iid-pixel significance or generalization claim

acceptance.engineering: all camera, leakage, schema and artifact checks pass, all original evidence retained; a negative metric result can still be a completed diagnostic
acceptance.risk_curve: descriptive only; do not flip gradient direction or tune gates from GT
acceptance.on_accuracy_failure: stop this fixed pilot; do not tune or add scenes/runs automatically
acceptance.on_success: supports reviewing external-scene confirmation and a separately falsifiable geometric-score hypothesis; does not authorize reliability weighting or GS training
acceptance.any_image_constant_zero_error: inconclusive_floor: strict per-image improvement is unattainable; no division by zero or success claim

isolation.predictor_mounts: bubblewrap allowlist: only selected train RGB/camera export, fixed source/weights, required runtime/libs, and new output; no parent-wide data/artifact mounts
isolation.evaluator_process: separate CPU process with read-only sealed predictions and evaluator-only native GT; output separate
isolation.CPU_helper_environments: OpenCV main env extracts features; separate pycolmap 4.2.1 CPU helper only consumes selected cameras/keypoints for ray math; never load a Reconstruction containing upstream points
isolation.namespace_and_GPU_mount_availability: not yet tested; mandatory synthetic isolation preflight before use
isolation.old_audit_hook_limit: scoped to data.parent and not a native-code security sandbox; current sibling evaluator layout must not rely on it
mandatory_denial_tests: sentinel evaluator label cannot be opened by Python, os.open, NumPy or OpenCV in predictor wrapper
changing evaluator labels does not change predictor input manifest or synthetic outputs
isolation.on_unavailable_isolation: blocked_isolation; stop, no broad mount fallback

resources.GPU_forward_preflight: future explicit approval only, unchanged shape/precision; OOM or anomaly stops, no auto retry or image shrink

release_order: this step: plan review and freeze only
next separate authorization: minimal CPU adapter, synthetic camera/geometry/masking/isolation checks and one three-RGB anchor-support preparation; no weights load or inference
only after CPU gates and explicit authorization: GPU forward preflight and exactly one Small pass per view, then unified CPU GT evaluation
stop and report all negative and unknown outcomes; no reliability weighting or training
cumulative_contribution: independent sensor-reference protocol and falsifiable metric-viability check; no new method or measured gain established

runtime.evaluator: existing Python3.10.22, NumPy1.26.4; no CUDA or model import; PCG64 version fixed
